harness.description: Terminal workbench that finds vulnerabilities with AI, then validates them live with PoC scripts.

uses.quote: A terminal workbench for AI-driven vulnerability discovery **and live validation**.
Once a scan starts, validators do whatever the plan calls for — drive the UI, run shell commands, write PoC scripts, host helper servers, collect logs, save screenshots.
